skills.name: Basic Attack: Warmup Sparks
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Fire Suppression
skills.desc:
Press  at the right moment activate:
Unleashes a set of more powerful slashes, dealing Fire DMG.
Performing 11 consecutive fire slashes with this skill will unlock the Inter-Knot Hot Topic achievement Mind Art Master.

skills.name: Dodge: Tempered Fire
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Blazing Fire
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Fire Suppression
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Backdraft
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Executes a powerful slash against enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Covering Fire
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the on-field character is launched, press  to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Hold the Line
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Reignition
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and cross slash enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Raging Fire
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Fervent Fire
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks will trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Uplifting Flame
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks trigger Fire Suppression for the next 30s, up to 8 times.

skills.name: Ultimate: Bellowing Flame
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks trigger Fire Suppression for the next 30s, up to 8 times.

skills.name: Core Passive: Heatwave
skills.desc: When triggering Fire Suppression during a Basic Attack or Dash Attack, increase that attack's DMG by X%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Fields of Fire
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Soldier 11 deals 10% more Fire DMG. When attacking Stunned enemies, this effect is further enhanced by an additional 22.5%.
This Additional Ability triggers from New Eridu Defense Force teammates, not just those from Obol Squad. For example, Soldier 0 - Anby, a Silver Squad Agent, can activate this Additional Ability.

cons.name: Rapid Heat
cons.desc: When Soldier 11 enters combat or switches in, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.

cons.name: Scorching Convergence
cons.desc: When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.

cons.name: Elite Soldier
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Indulgent Blaze
cons.desc:
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's Basic Attack or a Dash Attack, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.

cons.name: Perfect Soldier
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Scorching Flow
cons.desc:
When Soldier 11 uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks).
When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.
